// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1877): styled.Image and styled('Image') draw a picture, none with the prop.
const Member = styled.Image;
const Called = styled('Image');
const Double = styled("ImageBackground");
const Tagged = styled.Image`
  width: 40px;
`;
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Member source={{ uri }} />
      <Called source={{ uri }} />
      <Double source={{ uri }} />
      <Tagged source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
